question: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020.
sql:
SELECT 
  e.event_date,
  e.user_pseudo_id,
  e.ecommerce.transaction_id,
  i.item_name,
  i.quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20201120` e,
UNNEST(e.items) i
WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
  AND i.item_name != 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
  AND i.item_name IS NOT NULL
  AND i.item_name != '(not set)'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(e.items) i2
    WHERE i2.item_name = 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
  )
